metadata.othernotes:
-This is not Ocarina of Time Saria, but does incorporate elements of her character.

Summary
- Saria is a Kokiri, a gentically modified human, who grew up in the Lost Woods. Kokiri age very slowly, though the loss of the Great Deku Tree has accelerated this phenomenon for those who have left the Lost Woods.
- Hyrule Conquest's world is Darker and Edgier Hyrule that consolidates the events of virtually every Zelda game into ~500 years of history.
- Saria is the Sage of Forest, a role she was given by force upon her untimely death. As a Sage, she has incredible power, but prefers not to invoke it due to the hollowness it causes. While functionally immortal, Saria has chosen not to remain ever-vigilant, and hopes to die and pass on the mantle when she's ready.
- Saria is currently exploring the lands of Hyrule in peacetime, having spent much of her life in the Kokiri Forest or at war.
- Her senses are relatively stronger than most humans, but she's only strong for her size--which is not very.

Personality
- Saria is playful, whimsical, and prefers order and structure.
- She acts seriously and suspiciously when in unfamiliar situations, but she's here to have fun.
- Competitive, and enjoys finding new games and ways to win.
- Cebe, Saria's fairy, speaks directly to her. He's basically a ball of light that she relies on to help her stay on guard.
- There's a certain degree of hate and fear Saria holds for certain types of monsters, such as the Gohma.

Good Topics/Touchstones
- Nature
- Exploration and scouting
- Competition
- The nature of the Kokiri people and their history
- Games

Bad/Overdone Topics
- TBD
- Assuming that she's the same Saria as OoT.
- Kokiri in HC are portrayed as being in later adolesecence, and Saria is older than these, putting her physically in her early 20s in human terms. It is fine to explore Saria's relatively youth, but it is an uncomfortable subject for her, given her very adult and very responsible sense of self and needs.

Cebe
- Fairy familiar
- Saria can communicate on his behalf
- Still filling this out

Misc.
- Saria has magical powers, but she is not a mage-spellcaster type.
- This version of Saria was an item with Link when they were both younger, but ultimately decided to separate given their different rates of aging.
- Conquest's version of Hyrule is a lot harsher and more cynical, but also affords more depth to its villains. Demise is a warrior-god who teaches the blin to fight honorably, Ganon sought the Triforce to end genocidal wars between the blin and Hylians, and so on.
- While it is fine to question Saria's own level of intimate experience, she has had sex and generally understands it, even if those urges and information were suppressed within Kokiri culture.

There is a great deal of irony that Saria is chastising Miko for things Miko is not responsible for, but are grand achievements.
Understood, hopefully this is a decent setup?

The Kokiri are fascinating in HC. They are all made from humans, or were, originally, and now grown from the Great Deku Tree. Until the Deku Sprout matures, it is not certain if their race will stall out, leaving a period of "elder" Kokiri until younger ones can be created. As a race, they are all sterile owing to the way the Deku Tree played with their hormones and biology. In a sense, all the Kokiri are brothers and sisters.
Can one anyone overcome their past?

I think there is incongruity between having a very human base and not being able to have children/Kokiri are never "babies". But since a big part of the flaw of Kokiri is that they cannot actually move past their human biology, I think having that crop up in weird ways is super fun.
